data.memory_usage_summary: Dispatched three parallel Explore subagents (orchestrator, web UI, infra/auth) to produce an independent multi-layer inventory (per mem_9ff146f5), and the plan explicitly calls out the exact env-var contracts (INTEXURAOS_REPOSITORY_URL, INTEXURAOS_GITHUB_APP_INSTALLATION_ID, INTEXURAOS_USAGE_WEBHOOK_URL) that must change or be re-keyed per task (per mem_c32726ac).
data.summary:
* Task: scope the work to make IntexuraOS capable of running code tasks against repositories other than pbuchman/intexuraos, covering UX and configuration.
  * Decision: PLAN-DOC (investigation deliverable, no subtasks, single plan document plus evidence PR).
  * Artifacts: `docs/plans/2026-04-20-multi-repo-support-investigation.md`, planning branch `plan/int-1423-multi-repo-support`, PR #1889 targeting `development`, Linear issue description updated to point at the plan, original description archived as a Linear comment.
  * Findings: orchestrator is hardcoded single-repo at bootstrap; dispatch contract, web UI, GitHub App token pool, worker bootstrap, and Firestore indexes all need changes. Task model already carries a `repository` field, so display-side is mostly ready.
  * Estimate: 22–31 engineer-days full product (~5–7 weeks one engineer, ~3 weeks with two), or ~2 weeks for a same-org MVP reusing the existing GitHub App installation.
